data.name: Jacinto
data.long_meaning: The name Jacinto comes from the Latin word 'jacinthus', which means hyacinth flower. In Greek mythology, Hyacinthus was a beautiful youth loved by both Apollo and Zephyrus. When Apollo became jealous of Zephyrus' affections, he killed Hyacinthus accidentally. Apollo then transformed Hyacinthus' blood into a beautiful flower as a tribute to his love.
